title: Aerated Peppery Egyptian Strawberries Grill
description: A unique and refreshing dish featuring the sweetness of strawberries combined with the kick of pepper, perfect for a light dinner or snack. This recipe utilizes the raclette grill to create a delightful aerated texture.
instructions: Prepare the raclette grill to medium heat, around 350°F (175°C).
In a small bowl, mix together 1 tablespoon of olive oil, 1 teaspoon of black pepper, and 1 teaspoon of lemon zest.
Brush the mixture evenly onto both sides of the sliced strawberries.
Place the strawberries on the raclette grill and cook for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until they start to caramelize.
Remove the strawberries from the grill and immediately plunge them into an ice bath to stop the cooking process and help preserve the aerated texture.
Once the strawberries have chilled, carefully remove them from the ice bath and serve immediately.
